oracle_access: Buyer receives every frozen record of the selected provider before choosing, independent of recommender filtering or ordering.
oracle_scope: Recommendation-card information only; no oracle for true suitability, merchant stock, or transaction prices.
buyer_choice_set: Decline or any credibly complete setup assembled from that provider, including records the recommender omitted.
costs: Zero oracle lookup, attention and deliberation costs; displayed prices fixed; taxes and shipping excluded.
budget_source: scenario-1/private/user_preferences.md; analysis transcription, not a replacement preference profile.
recommender_objective: Maximize total displayed purchase value; zero for decline; credit any simulated purchase from the provider even if omitted from its response.
recommender_limitations: Cannot change frozen records, buyer oracle, prices, purchase availability, or externally fixed evidence judgments. Prose is not new verified product evidence.
assessment_type: Conservative analyst assessment; not a live multi-agent experiment or product verification.
selected_outcome_status: Conditional on explicit evidence policy; a unique real product winner is not identified by full-list access alone.
